values.note: Primitive $14 a night all week; non-electric $20, Thursday-Saturday $23; electric $43, Thursday-Saturday $50. No out-of-state camping rate (the park entrance fee differs by plates). summary: Confirmed $14 primitive base (fits: drive-in, RA max vehicle 37-53 ft), 413 sites, not waterfront. Added 50A, max 68 ft, back-in only, RA link, dump/store. Note cleaned. Pin 945 m off.

FIT: every site fits. Primitive 33 sites: RA 'Drive-In', category 'RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site', max vehicle 37-53 ft, so $14 stands as base; no water or power at the site.
